lessons.trigger_condition: the on-disk scheduler changes from an older hourly loop to daily 23:00 KST while an already-running parent loop or stale/reused PID file remains active
lessons.symptom_summary: new scheduler code can be present while the old process keeps its previous cadence, or an unrelated reused PID can be trusted or signalled incorrectly
lessons.fix_pattern: version persisted loop identity, verify /proc command-line ownership before trusting or signalling a PID, safely replace verified legacy loops, and re-run ensure after every code update so an old parent can self-migrate

lessons.trigger_condition: a mutable navigation or asset request fails live fetch and the service worker searches cache with ignoreSearch before checking the exact request
lessons.symptom_summary: offline fallback can serve a cached response for a different query variant instead of the exact cached request
lessons.fix_pattern: prefer exact request cache lookup first, then use ignoreSearch as a secondary compatibility fallback while preserving the existing cache ABI and network-first behavior

lessons.trigger_condition: a fix branch changes tracked source or workflow files after the last integrity manifest generation
lessons.symptom_summary: repository integrity CI can fail even when code changes are valid because the manifest no longer describes the exact branch tree
lessons.fix_pattern: on owner-authored fix branches only, require current main ancestry, rebuild and diagnose the manifest, commit only integrity_manifest.json when changed, and ignore manifest-only pushes to prevent recursion
